get.description: Liveness probe; carries no dependencies so it succeeds even before Spotify auth.
Return the authenticated Spotify user's id and display name.

List the user's playlists with load/cache state, Liked Songs first.

``track_count`` stays None for Liked Songs until a refresh job loads it — Spotify's saved-tracks endpoint offers no cheap count without fetching pages.

post.description:
Start (or join) a background job that fetches the playlist and builds its dataset.

Cache-warm loads also run as jobs — they finish in seconds and keep the client's flow uniform. A queued or running job for the same playlist is joined,
not duplicated.

get.description:
Return the flattened track rows of a loaded playlist.

Raises:
    DatasetNotLoadedError: Mapped to HTTP 409 when no refresh job has loaded the playlist yet.
Tag/genre frequency bars — the primary rule-helper chart (bar click → tag filter).
Tracks per release year, pre-binned server-side so a bar click/box-select maps to exact years.
Library growth: additions per period plus cumulative tracks/hours.
Artist discovery waves: how many artists enter the library for the first time per period.
Additions by calendar month aggregated across years (always 12 rows).
Track counts per credited artist; repeatable ``genre`` params implement the cascading genre→artist re-scope.
Release-year vs added-year scatter rows; carries track ids so a lasso selection can become a playlist.

post.description:
Dry-run the spec against the loaded playlist: bucket contents and stats, nothing written anywhere.

Raises:
    DatasetNotLoadedError: Mapped to 409 when the playlist has no loaded dataset.
    ValueError: Mapped to 400 for invalid specs (inverted bounds, duplicate bucket names, ...).

Materialize chosen buckets as NEW playlists under a named batch (background job).

Validation happens before the job starts so spec errors surface synchronously; the job then re-runs the pure assignment and performs the
only writes in the API: create playlist + add tracks per non-empty bucket. Empty buckets are skipped and reported.

Raises:
    DatasetNotLoadedError: Mapped to 409 when the playlist has no loaded dataset.
    ValueError: Mapped to 400 for invalid specs or bucket_names not present in the spec.

get.description: The local history of Apply batches, newest first.

Return the current snapshot of a background job.

Raises:
    NotFoundError: Mapped to HTTP 404 when the job id is unknown or already evicted.
